company.name: Kyber
company.shortDescription: Kyber is a ChatGPT for enterprise support that embeds AI intelligence into enterprise support workflows.
company.description: Kyber operates in the artificial intelligence and B2B industries, focusing on automating the insurance industry using LLMs. Kyber's primary offering is a ChatGPT for enterprise support, which embeds AI intelligence into enterprise support workflows. This technology is designed to accelerate customer success teams by providing immediate, factual answers to queries. Kyber's platform is the first Generative AI automation platform for the insurance industry, aiming to streamline and enhance the efficiency of support workflows.
